title: microderis rigens
intro: Microderis rigens, commonly known as Yellow Sage, is a perennial plant species in the family Lamiaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which can aid in the treatment of various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Microderis rigens include its ability to reduce fever, relieve cough and cold symptoms, and act as a digestive aid. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
